limitations: Original extents use the next direct-call/relocation/entrypoint-derived entry; names exist only in the current symbol ELF.
Normalization masks signed direct-call operands and relocated immediates only; it does not establish callee or literal equivalence.
Every direct relocation in the recorded windows is inventoried. Bounded data previews preserve exact bytes but are not complete consumed-extent proofs for all descriptors.
No full handler equivalence, complete transitive closure, dynamic coverage, or original source text is claimed.
